notes.title: Mojo 3
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34107371/7290cba6df4ec779cad1d7c2aba3b27e31589fe3.png

The future of Mojo 3 (both the commercial game and the free promo version) is still uncertain. We have been clearly witnessing a substantially decreasing interest of the community towards the game since the second part was released.

Mojo: Hanako and Mojo 2: Mia have shown equal number of downloads but the figures of the latter has fallen:

 50% fewer users have completed the game (24.6 vs. 12.5);
 40% fewer reviews have been added (650 vs. 392).


Mojo XXX is a litmus test for us. The decision about Mojo 3 will be taken basing on the results of the game release.

The future of the Mojo game series is in your hands.
